ns2:course.label: Leadership and Management
ns2:course.description: Leadership and Management is a study of organizational behavior and management with an emphasis on situational leadership. Students will explore a variety of leadership and management topics including the classical theories of management, motivation, and communication to help prepare students for leadership challenges in any environment and any industry. Prerequisite: No prerequisite for non-NROTC students.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: No prerequisite for non-NROTC students.
